title: Implementation of Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Operational Guidelines
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

Implementation of Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Operational Guidelines

Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Unveils 7X7X7 Framework to Accelerate Anemia Reduction
New Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Guidelines Focus on Testing, Treatment, Tracking and Dietary Diversification

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
11 AUG 2026 1:36PM by PIB Delhi

The Government of India has recently released the Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Operational guidelines during the 16
th
 Central Council of Health and Family Welfare (CCHFW) meeting on 29
th
 June 2026 to address anemia through a 7X7X7 strategy, moving ahead from the older 6X6X6 strategy of Anemia Mukt Bharat programme. The components of Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan are:

Saturation of Hb testing using Digital Invasive Hemoglobinometers at platforms based on beneficiary group.

P
rophylaxis and targeted therapeutic management as per category of anemia diagnosed.

Segregation of nutritional anemia and non-nutritional anemia for appropriate case-base management.

Robust digital system for tracking anemia services: Shift from T3 approach (Test, Treat, Talk) toward T4 approach (Test, Treat, Talk and Track)

Dietary diversification with Eat Right Approach and promotion of locally available iron rich foods on everyday basis.

Implementation of convergent approach- ‘whole of Government Approach’ for implementation of complementary interventions, inter-ministerial convergence

‘Jan Bhagidari- Communication strategy for transformation of mindset from passive acceptance of anemia to active ownership (for Test, Treat, Talk and Track)

The details of 7X7X7 framework under Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan are as follows:

The seven beneficiaries are:

Children 6-59 months

Children 5-9 years

Adolescents 10-19 years

Pregnant women

Lactating mothers

Women in reproductive age (20-49 years)

0-6 months LBW babies

The seven interventions are:

Prophylactic IFA Supplementation

Testing of anemia

Therapeutic management of anemia

Deworming and Delayed Cord Clamping

Jan Bhagidari- communication strategy to counteract normalised perception of anemia and improve compliance to IFA supplementation

Addressing non-nutritional causes of anemia

Eating Right – promotion of locally available iron rich food and diet diversification

The seven Institutional mechanisms are:

Intra-ministerial coordination

National Centre of Excellence and Advanced Research on Anemia

National AMB Abhiyaan Unit

Strengthening supply chain and logistics

Convergence with other Ministries

Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Portal

Digital Framework for monitoring through T4 approach

The T4 approach includes Testing for anemia, Treatment for anemia, Talk for awareness and compliance through Jan Bhagidari, and Tracking the beneficiaries for treatment, referral and follow-up. The digital framework has been entailed under Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan
 to record, strengthen digital tracking and monitoring of anemia services.
 The beneficiaries are tested for anemia across platforms, pregnant and lactating mothers registered in
JANANI Portal, school going children registered in RBSK portal and children for vaccination registered in U-WIN portal. The categorization of anemia into mild, moderate and severe anemia and appropriate management of anemia as per protocols is envisioned under
Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan.

The Union Minister of State for Health and Family Welfare,
Smt. Anupriya Patel
 stated this in a written reply in the Rajya Sabha today.

*****
